decisions.reason: The bottle-and-smoke clipping correction applies to the standalone strawberry asset, not the separate steak-and-onion grill illustration.
Although this separate illustration also contains a bottle, the source context specifically concerns the bottle and smoke in the standalone strawberry asset and does not change this design.
The stamped-meat illustration has no bottle-or-smoke visibility requirement affected by the source decision.
The source decision about retaining and fully displaying a bottle and smoke does not affect the Riverton sky-text illustration.
Changing the included elements and clipping constraint of one asset does not alter the project-wide hand-drawn, non-AI production requirement.
The source decision changes illustration composition and visibility, not the required green-background and non-green-background PNG variants.
